pages.text: There is no iron ore block. There is $(bold)hematite$(), which is what iron ore is called in the ground. Geolosys names every deposit after its mineral, and the mineral tells you the metal.$(br2)$(bold)Hematite, Limonite$() = iron$(br)$(bold)Malachite, Azurite$() = copper$(br)$(bold)Sphalerite$() = zinc$(br)$(bold)Cassiterite, Teallite$() = tin

$(bold)Galena$() = lead, with silver in it$(br)$(bold)Bauxite$() = aluminum$(br)$(bold)Cinnabar$() = redstone$(br)$(bold)Kimberlite$() = diamond$(br)$(bold)Beryl$() = emerald$(br)$(bold)Lignite, Bituminous, Anthracite$() = coal, soft to hard$(br)$(bold)Platinum, Gold, Lapis, Quartz$() are themselves.

Mine a mineral and you get a $(bold)cluster$() of its metal, never a raw ore. Tin, lead, silver, nickel, aluminum and platinum ingots have no machines of their own here; Spartan Weaponry turns them into spears, blades and shields with their own weights and reach.$(br2)Uranium is not in this world. Anything else you dig up, EMI knows a use for.
